subskill: Predict a 'not' outcome count from experimental results
grade_rationale: Mid for grade 7 (7.SP.C.6): the student must turn a frequency table into an experimental probability for the complement (96 - 12 = 84 of 96), then scale it to a new number of trials (84/96 x 200).
